I implemented the calculator in `src/main.cpp` and added `build.sh`, which builds an optimized binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases.

I also checked some edge cases by hand, and each gave the result SPEC.md asks for:
- `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` prints `0`.
- `-9223372036854775808` prints `error`, because the literal itself is too large.
- Dividing the smallest value by `-1` prints `error`.
- Unary minus binds tighter than `*`, so `-2*3` is `-6`.
